name: phase_01_oidc_sessions
lock_risk: Adds one nullable session label, replaces two small check constraints, and creates two initially empty Identity tables with one partial index.
representative_data: Runs against the deterministic three-principal seed with one revoked session and against empty, version-two, and version-four migration lanes.
query_plan_review: Unique verifier, state, and principal-idempotency indexes support single-row authentication and replay paths; the partial expiry index bounds pending transaction cleanup.
space_risk: Adds only bounded short-lived OIDC transaction rows and one compact revocation replay record per accepted idempotency key.
forward_fix: Correct released session protocol state with a new ordered migration while preserving consumed transactions, revocations, and audit facts.
rollback: Disable runtime identity routes and reject sessions; never restore a revoked session, browser bearer token, consumed OIDC transaction, or deleted audit fact.
